_note: EU/EEA national-chain round, 21 countries that each had exactly three nodes (EDP inventory, ESS peer review report, national accounts) and ZERO country-internal dependency edges — they hung off the Eurostat/ESA hubs and nothing else. This round mints each country's own price index, household budget survey and labour force survey, and wires the three documented domestic dependencies between them: CPI/HICP weights from national accounts household final consumption expenditure, CPI/HICP weights from the HBS, and national-accounts employment from the LFS. It also resolves the granularity question left open in eurostat-hicp.json (_open_questions, 2026-08-05: 'if a future session wants country-level granularity for HICP... this node may need to be split'): eurostat-hicp now has incoming uses_data_from edges from the national HICPs it aggregates, rather than being split. Researched by 21 parallel subagents, one per country, each told a guessed answer is worse than none and required to WebFetch and quote. FOUR load-bearing quotes were independently re-fetched and confirmed verbatim by the orchestrating session before minting: Poland's Eurostat ESMS weights sentence, Ireland's CSO CPI background-notes HFMCE/HBS sentences, Austria's std_v_vpi_hvpi.pdf Gewichtung sentence, and Greece's Eurostat ESMS weights sentence. METHOD FINDING worth reusing: the two Eurostat national reference metadata URL patterns are the highest-yield source for this whole class of question — https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/cache/metadata/EN/prc_hicp_esmshi4_<cc>.htm (HICP weights + transmission) and https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/cache/metadata/EN/employ_simslfs_<cc>.htm (whether the LFS is the national-accounts employment source, stated as an explicit Y/N field). CAUTION: the HICP filename is versioned per country and NOT uniform — esmshi4 for PL/EL/ES/HU/HR/BG/LT, esmshi3 for SK/SI/EE/LV/MT/CY/IS, and 404 for FI. Try hi4, fall back to hi3. NEGATIVE FINDINGS ARE REAL DATA here, not gaps: the employ_simslfs pages state outright that Cyprus 'doesn't make use of LFS, or makes minimal use of it' for national accounts and that Slovenia is the same, so those two countries correctly have NO national-accounts<-LFS edge — see _dropped. Spain, Hungary, Slovakia, Croatia, Latvia and Lithuania are documented as using the LFS as a main-but-not-sole source, and their edge bases quote that caveat rather than overclaiming. NOT DONE this round: no government-finance / EDP notification node was researched for any of the 21 — every agent deprioritised it in favour of the CPI/HBS/LFS core, so treat it as unresearched rather than absent. Portugal is the thinnest country here: ine.pt refused essentially every fetch (robots.txt ConnectTimeout, reproduced independently by the orchestrating session), so pt-ine-idef's url points at the INE IPC release that evidences it rather than at IDEF's own page, no Portuguese LFS node exists, and Romania lost its IAPC node to the same failure mode on insse.ro.
